name: SAR 7/24 C Platinum
lead: The SAR 7/24 C combines the clear, decisive and professional design approach of Sarsılmaz's newest advanced-engineered pistol series SAR 7/24 with a compact body specially developed for concealed carry.
description: The SAR 7/24 C combines the clear, decisive and professional design approach of Sarsılmaz's newest advanced-engineered pistol series SAR 7/24 with a compact body specially developed for concealed carry.

The flat trigger design with a single-action trigger system and adjustable reset distance distinguish the SAR 7/24 C from its competitors with the advantage of faster first shots, practical use and safe transportation. The body design specially developed for the SAR 7/24 C is complemented by body lines that maximize ergonomic grip both during gripping and shooting. Another distinctive feature of the SAR 7/24 C is the vertical trigger guard that facilitates ergonomic grip. The SAR 7/24 C, which is fed with a double-row 17-round capacity magazine, has a barrel bushing mounted on the cover assembly, which increases the feeling of balanced shooting and provides an advantage in rapid firing. SAR 7/24 C also offers the user the highest level of shooting performance with its ergonomic structure that takes into account the weight balance factor suitable for the “full size” class.
